title: Count Number of Teams
summary: Given n soldiers with unique ratings, count how many valid teams of three can be formed where the ratings strictly increase or decrease in the order of the team members.
statement: Given n soldiers with unique ratings, count how many valid teams of three can be formed where the ratings strictly increase or decrease in the order of the team members.
constraints: Choose indices i<j<k with strictly increasing or strictly decreasing ratings.
reference_solution:
def count_monotonic_teams(rating):
 answer=0
 for j,middle in enumerate(rating):
  lower_left=sum(value<middle for value in rating[:j]);higher_left=j-lower_left
  lower_right=sum(value<middle for value in rating[j+1:]);higher_right=len(rating)-j-1-lower_right
  answer+=lower_left*higher_right+higher_left*lower_right
 return answer

Count lower and higher values on both sides.
Multiply lower-left by higher-right, and higher-left by lower-right.
Every valid triple has exactly one middle index, so each is counted once.
